subject: sr-maths
title: Mathematical Reasoning
meta: Lesson practice set · Question types of the April 2026 NIOS paper
instructions: Practice set for this lesson in the question types of the April 2026 paper.
Every answer shows the working. Where a question has OR, answer either one.
Questions from previous NIOS papers show the exam they appeared in.

questions.q: The converse of 'if a number is divisible by 9, then it is divisible by 3' is —
options: if a number is divisible by 3, then it is divisible by 9
if a number is divisible by 9, then it is not divisible by 3
if a number is not divisible by 3, it is not divisible by 9
if a number is not divisible by 9, then it is also not divisible by 3
questions.work: Converse of p ⇒ q is q ⇒ p: swap the two parts.

questions.q: The converse of 'If x is divisible by 4, then x is even' is —
options: If x is not divisible by 4, then x is not even
If x is even, then x is divisible by 4
If x is even, then x is not divisible by 4
If x is not divisible by 4, then x is even

questions.q: The converse of 'If n is a positive number, then n³ is a positive number' is —
options: If n is not positive, then n³ is not positive
If n³ is not positive, then n is not positive
If n³ is positive, then n is positive
If n is positive, then n³ is not positive

questions.q: The contrapositive of 'If you are born in India, then you are a citizen of India' is —
options: If you are a citizen of India, then you are born in India
If you are not a citizen of India, then you are not born in India
You are born in India if and only if you are a citizen of India
You are born in India or you are a citizen of India

questions.q: Which of these is a statement?
options: Close the door.
How old are you?
7 is a prime number.
What a lovely day!

sections.title: Objective type questions of two 1-mark parts.

questions.q: Write the negation of: (a) The capital of Gujarat is Ahmedabad. (b) All circles are congruent.
questions.answer:
(a) The capital of Gujarat is not Ahmedabad.
(b) Some circles are not congruent (not all circles are congruent).

questions.q: Write the negation of: (i) The number is less than 5. (ii) All prime numbers are odd.
questions.answer:
(i) The number is not less than 5.
(ii) Some prime numbers are not odd (e.g. 2).

questions.q: Write the contrapositive of: (i) If ABCD is a square, then it is a rhombus. (ii) If a and b are rational numbers, then ab is a real number.
questions.answer:
(i) If ABCD is not a rhombus, then it is not a square.
(ii) If ab is not a real number, then a and b are not both rational.

questions.q: Write in the form 'if … then': (a) It never rains when it is cold. (b) A quadrilateral is a parallelogram if its diagonals bisect each other.
questions.answer:
(a) If it is cold, then it never rains.
(b) If the diagonals of a quadrilateral bisect each other, then it is a parallelogram.

sections.title: Objective type questions of four 1-mark parts.

questions.q: (a) Negate: '√5 is not a rational number.' (b) Converse of 'If x is a prime number, then x is even.' (c) Contrapositive of 'If a number is odd, then its square is not negative.' (d) Combine with 'if and only if': P: if two angles of a triangle are equal, it is isosceles; Q: if a triangle is isosceles, two of its angles are equal.
questions.answer:
(a) √5 is a rational number.
(b) If x is even, then x is a prime number.
(c) If the square of a number is negative, then the number is not odd.
(d) A triangle is isosceles if and only if two of its angles are equal.

questions.q: Write the converse and contrapositive of 'If a triangle is equilateral, then it is isosceles'.
questions.answer:
Converse: if a triangle is isosceles, then it is equilateral (false in general).
Contrapositive: if a triangle is not isosceles, then it is not equilateral (true, equivalent to the original).
